budget_window.rule: Spend deliberately. Do not raise budget until demo-line calls, checkout intent, and payment flow remain clean.

recommended_structure.reason: Existing winner data favors call_now/live proof, price anchor, missed-call pain, and 15-34s video formats. Meta is the fastest place to test many short creatives on a $2k budget.

phase_plan.landing_policy: Use homepage or direct call for proof ads; use /pay or the production Square pilot checkout path for pilot-close traffic.

phase_plan.live_ads_rule: Keep the best call-now ad and best price/pilot ad. Replace weak ads with owner-night and emergency/missed-call variants.
phase_plan.rotation_rule: Change one variable at a time: hook, first visual, or CTA. Do not change all three at once.

first_ads_to_launch.why: Winner data says live proof and call_now are strongest. Wallace founder proof is a sharp pattern interrupt.

red.action: pause and replace creative before adding budget

measurement.manual_review_cadence: Review spend, calls, checkout intent, and payment proof every morning before raising budget.
